implement: legion-worker: PR body, proof objects, push and handoff rules, the simplify pass and the production check after the close (references/pr-body.md, merge-gate.md, findings.md)
ce-simplify-code: the implementer's one simplify pass per pull request (legion-worker references/pr-body.md)
dispatch: the production-check comment and any Dispatch write the implementer makes
asd-ste100: Envoy messages to the architect, the controller and other trees (INFRA-546, INFRA-627 coordination)
test: legion-worker: the tester's proof objects, re-running the plan's commands, the E2E lines and handoff (references/pr-body.md, merge-gate.md)
dispatch: any finding the tester posts on the issue
review: legion-worker: review threads, the approval by head SHA and the merge gate (references/review-threads.md, merge-gate.md, pr-body.md)

findings.finding: Per-issue reads (6a/6c) break the spec's per-issue cost bound and the implement App's hourly limit.
findings.answer: Decision 4/W6a: one paged open-PR listing per served repository per pass; W6 request budget asserted by a counting stand-in; recorded as spec departure 1.

findings.finding: 'Recorded in any phase' includes done; per-issue reads over non-done issues depart from it.
findings.answer: The per-repository listing covers every phase, done included (W6a); no departure remains on phases.

findings.finding: The daemon's NATS grant has no STREAM.MSG.GET, so reading the oldest waiting message would be refused.
findings.answer: W9 adds $JS.API.STREAM.MSG.GET.ENVOY_NOTIFICATIONS to daemonpermissions.Grant() with its test and infra docs; a refused read reports 'unavailable' and the state is still served; rollout via the envoy-infra plugin noted for the architect.

findings.finding: A clustered stream keeps a refused MsgId, so every redelivery is refused (ErrNotStored) until Expired.
findings.answer: W2: if #2362 merged first, the listener republishes once without the MsgId after ErrNotStored (seq 0 means no stored copy), tested on #2362's cluster helper; otherwise reported to the architect for INFRA-546 (section 6).

findings.finding: A PR merged early leaves the implementer refused forever under HANDOFF_NO_PULL_REQUEST.
findings.answer: W7: the refusal message names a recorded closed or merged PR and says the architect was told (existing pr-merged / pr-closed-unmerged notices) and decides the phase, per early_merge_test.go's rule; tests for closed and merged records.

findings.finding: The synthetic settlement can block later Envoy settlements (Mixed = Conflict); no-run settlements; suites; review App id.
findings.answer: Decision 6/W6d: pass settlement marked Generation -1 and merged name by name against Envoy's; built only with >=1 run, all completed, newest older than one pass; tester/architect runs filtered by the review App id from GET /app; classify tests on the real replay listing.

findings.finding: The stream's 72 h MaxAge is itself a limit.
findings.answer: W4 logs ERROR when a stored position is older than the stream's first message; the pass heals those PRs; noted for the architect (section 6) as equal to GitHub's own window.

findings.finding: SetRepositories also recreates a missing consumer mid-run with DeliverNew.
findings.answer: W4 puts the stored-position start in openConsumer, used by both OpenConsumers and SetRepositories; tests for both paths.

findings.finding: Decision 4 covered only the GitHub consumer; the spec says 'a consumer'.
findings.answer: Decision 3/W4: all three durable consumers use the stored position; tests for GitHub and dispatch-server consumers.

findings.finding: 'Issue records' is ambiguous; narrowing to non-done leaves live records growing.
findings.answer: Decision 8 and spec departure 3: met for finished records, live ones bounded by the cap; benchmark mix fixed (350 slotted roots with children, rest done); rows-read test over six fact kinds.

findings.finding: Activity API gaps: branch_creation, 422/pagination, unfollowable chain, maxWaitingPushes, idempotency on main.
findings.answer: W6c: push, force_push and branch_creation; one page of 100; unfollowable chain applies no push, logs WARN, synchronize as today; idempotency re-checked on main and tested with a late webhook push; live actor-login read quoted.

findings.finding: 72 h from the oldest attempt seen; GitHub refusing a too-old request; missing acceptance tests.
findings.answer: Decision 2/W1: a cursorless sweep looks back 72 h so the first attempt is listed; a 404 to the request expires with its reason; tests for 401 past 5 attempts recovered with INFO count, Expired at 72 h with ERROR, legacy Terminal/Exhausted retried.

findings.finding: Sweep throughput and INFRA-627 ordering; record shape for the next-due time.
findings.answer: W1 stores NextAttemptAt for INFRA-627's index; agreed order kept (#2387 first); benchmark at 1,000 and 10,000 not-due records with zero GitHub requests; the bucket already holds every record 72 h, so entry count is unchanged.

findings.finding: CI settlements have loss paths of their own (overflow, unassociated runs).
findings.answer: W2 largest-envelope test includes the settlement at maxSettlementBytes; W6d's check-runs read heals unassociated and overflowed heads.

findings.finding: The push subject fix must go through the contracts generator.
findings.answer: W2 changes packages/contracts/scripts/gen-go.ts and src/subject.ts with both test suites; generated.go regenerated.

findings.finding: Decision 2's fallback copies #2362; stream-full needs MaxBytes.
findings.answer: Fallback dropped; W11 uses a stream that does not capture the subject (503) on main, and adds a stream-full case only with #2362.

findings.finding: #2387 changes what the W11 sweep needs (Dispatch Postgres for rate limits).
findings.answer: W11 runs the sweep with the Dispatch database #2387 needs if it merged; W1 is written on #2387's decide.

findings.finding: #2385 and #2365 rebase risk; workspace behind main.
findings.answer: Section 0: start from main@origin (4e350fdf has #2365); rebase on #2385 and reuse its Compare and head-ref check.

findings.finding: #2294 overlaps admission narrowing.
findings.answer: Section 0/W8: whichever merges first, the other rebases; W8 narrows TreeLive only if #2294 has not merged.

findings.finding: Stable event ids need the project and must not skip a real re-apply.
findings.answer: W6e: ids carry project, repository, number and the GitHub observation (head, updated_at, run-id set), never bootID or UnixNano; intake.Applied pre-skip.

findings.finding: Lag 'waiting', 'oldest', 'handled' need definitions; GetMsg outside the state transaction.
findings.answer: Decision 9 defines each; W9 reads outside the state transaction within 2 s; stalled test with a moved clock.

findings.finding: Refusal code naming and its message; every list of codes changes.
findings.answer: W7: HANDOFF_NO_PULL_REQUEST with a message naming repository, branch and any recorded PR state; every listed site updated, prompts_test implementer case, inverted handoff test.

findings.finding: 'Logs each delivery it stops asking for' needs a defined set.
findings.answer: W1: Expired (72 h or GitHub 404) at ERROR and Delivered after a request at INFO with the count; budget deferrals are not logged.

findings.finding: The webhook App check must not block boot; reasons for each failure.
findings.answer: W3: never refuses a repository or fails the boot probe; reasons for not installed, check failed, and a Dispatch without the route; Dispatch route with 503 GITHUB_APP_UNCONFIGURED and 502 GITHUB_UNREADABLE.

findings.finding: The new architect notice kind needs the outbox allowlist and docs; GitHub unreadable at both completion and pass.
findings.answer: W6f adds pull-request-missing to record/outbox.go and the architect's wake routing; persistent pass failures stay logged by logPassFailure and the pass retries every 2 minutes.

findings.finding: A 60 s timing assertion on shared CI runners is flaky; must run real handlers; include reviews/checks.
findings.answer: W10: functional assertions always; the 60 s bound under LEGION_TEST_DRAIN_MEASURE=1, run three times by implementer and tester; real mirror, engine and admission; reviews, checks and workflow runs in the 5,000.

findings.finding: The production check needs the private deployment; who runs it, command, evidence.
findings.answer: Section 4 row 3.4: the implementer's production check after the close, readings through the controller's read_state (agents never run legion state), quoted on the PR's Production: line and a Dispatch comment; departure 4.

findings.finding: Decode filters break intake tests on other branches; workflow_run filter needs Deploys in ConsumerSpec.
findings.answer: W8: intake tests updated; ConsumerSpec gains Deploys.

specDepartures.spec: Cost: the pass's new reads are at most one GitHub request per pass for each issue in the workflow whose record lacks an open pull request, or whose head has no CI settlement yet.
specDepartures.plan: One paged open-PR listing per served repository per pass, one check-runs read per head with no settlement, and only when a head moved without its push recorded, one activity read plus one compare per unrecorded push.
specDepartures.evidence: 'Recorded in any phase' includes done issues, which per-issue reads cannot cover inside the implement App's hourly limit at 30 passes an hour; #2365 judges a move by its chain of pushes, so a missed push needs the chain (GitHub repository activity API).

acceptance: Cost: the pass's new reads are at most one GitHub request per pass for each issue in the workflow whose record lacks an open pull request, or whose head has no CI settlement yet.

specDepartures.spec: A delivery refused for its signature, or one the listener could not turn into an envelope, is answered so that the sweep asks for it again.
specDepartures.plan: The listener keeps answering 401 and 400; the sweep asks again for every non-OK attempt, whatever its status.
specDepartures.evidence: sweep.go:482-493 is the only place a 4xx becomes final; one rule there makes 401, 400 and 422 retried, and a 401 keeps telling a sender without the secret nothing.

specDepartures.spec: A fact's cost does not grow with the number of issue records.
specDepartures.plan: Admission and per-fact reads take only the project's records not in phase done (bounded by admission's cap); done records, which accumulate and are never deleted, are read only for a named tree.
specDepartures.evidence: admit.go promoteHolds reads store.Issues (whole table) up to four times per fact; promoteHolds needs every live record; only reenterStrandedChildren needs done records, and only of one tree.

acceptance: A fact's cost does not grow with the number of issue records: read as finished (done) records; live records stay bounded by admission's cap.

specDepartures.spec: On the deployed INFRA daemon after its release, three legion state readings an hour apart each show its GitHub consumer's oldest waiting event younger than one minute.
specDepartures.plan: The three readings come through the project controller's read_state, which returns the same state, during the implementer's production check.
specDepartures.evidence: AGENTS.md, Commands: agents never run legion state; the controller reads the whole state with read_state.
